thread:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV_HIGH - multiple container restarts in prod inference pool (us-west-2). Metric: prefill_restarts spike to 12 in 15m. Affected model: gpt-large-8k-quant. Pager: @jamie_sre :rotating_light:
jamie_sre: Acknowledged, I'm on it. Triage in progress — checking recent deploys and node metrics.
carla_runtime: Not seeing a deploy. Heap of long-context requests from a single customer hitting prefill path. Likely large-window prefill causing GPU OOM during kv cache alloc.
ben_support: Customer-reported errors rolling in: "stream disconnected" and 502s around 15:32 UTC. Ticket #4521 shows 5% error rate for customer: acme-ml.
marcus_runtime: Dumping one of the failing container logs: ```2026-03-17T15:31:42Z ERROR runtime: CUDA out of memory when allocating 9216 MiB
stack: runtime/prefill.go:214 prefillTokens()
container: grpc-server-7f6c8 restart count=3
--- GPU_MEM_INFO ---
free: 0MB total: 32768MB used: 32768MB
```
amy_custops: Confirmed downstream queues saw ~20% latency spikes for streaming sessions during the window. Some requests retried by clients.
jamie_sre: Immediate mitigation options: 1) apply emergency routing: steer long-context requests to smaller model variant; 2) enable emergency prefill token truncation (max_context=4096); 3) cordon hot nodes. Which one can we do fast?
carla_runtime: I can flip routing within the console quickly. Suggest route fallback -> gpt-medium-8k-quant and enable prefix cache eviction. I'll prepare the CLI command.
marcus_runtime: CLI to create emergency route (ready to paste): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/emergency -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS" -d '{"match":{"path":"/v1/generate","predicates":[{"header":{"name":"x-context-tokens","op":"gt","value":6000}}]},"action":{"route_to":"gpt-medium-8k-quant","priority":1000}}'```
ben_support: Pasting sample client error from logs for ops reference: ```ERR client=10.4.5.21 stream broken: rpc error: code=Unavailable desc="server closed connection"
request: {"user_id":"acct-acme","tokens":12000,"model":"gpt-large-8k-quant"}```
infra-bot: Node summary for affected pool: node-az2-gpu-04 showing repeated docker restarts, kernel message: "NVRM: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus" — likely driver-level fault after OOM.
jamie_sre: Good catch. Plan: carla apply fallback route + enable prefill truncation; infra will cordon node-az2-gpu-04 and mitigate noisy neighbor by moving other workloads. ops-lead, I'll hand this to night on-call in 20m unless someone else stays.
carla_runtime: Applying fallback now. Command executed, waiting for propagation (TTL=30s). Also enabling prefill truncation patch: ```redwoodctl config set global.prefill.max_context 4096 --override emergency_2026-03-17```
marcus_runtime: Confirmed: traffic steering active, telemetry shows long-window requests dropping to smaller model. Prefill OOMs per-minute down from 6 to 1.
amy_custops: Customer acme-ml error rate dropped to 0.8% and streaming latency returning to baseline. They're being updated via support ticket.
jamie_sre: Infra will cordon node now to prevent restarts; offloading pods. infra-bot: start cordon node-az2-gpu-04.
infra-bot: Cordon initiated for node-az2-gpu-04. Eviction in progress.
ops-lead: Thanks team — keep the thread updated. I'll join postmortem. jamie_sre, if you need to hand off, call out the on-call user.
jamie_sre: Handoff to night on-call: @ben_support will take watch. I'll leave runbook notes in incident channel and set priority label. ETA 30m for full validation and to revert emergency flags.
ben_support: Taking over. I've noted the CLI commands and the emergency route. Monitoring closely.
marcus_runtime: We'll collect GPU kernel traces from the cordoned node and upload to the incident artifact bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/8032104567/trace.tar.gz
jamie_sre: Incident status: MITIGATED -> emergency routing + prefill truncation reduced OOM-driven restarts. Customer impact: acme-ml intermittent streaming errors during 15:28-15:40 UTC, peak error rate 5%, now resolved. Postmortem required to decide permanent guardrails (per-request context limits, smarter client-side warnings, and improved eviction).
incident-bot: Incident update logged. Tags: gpu-oom, prefill, emergency-route, customer-impact. Assignment: postmortem -> eng-runtime + SRE.
ben_support: Acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring and ping if error rate rises.
ops-lead: Nice work. After action items: 1) auto-fallback policy for >8k tokens, 2) runtime soft limits on prefill allocations, 3) better telemetry for noisy customers.
jamie_sre: Adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-gpu-oom
ben_support: Closing thread for now — will re-open if we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
